newsitem.title: UK: Child dies in crash near royal Scottish castle.
newsitem.headline: Child dies in crash near royal Scottish castle.

text.p: A child died and five other people were injured when a helicopter crashed on Sunday about a mile (1.6 km) from Glamis Castle, the Scottish home of Britain's Queen Mother, a fire brigade spokesman said.

He said the helicopter was one of a number giving rides to handicapped children attending the Glamis Extravaganza, an event being organised at the castle by a vintage car club, which had been hit by heavy rain.
The 96-year-old Queen Mother, whose daughter Queen Elizabeth is Britain's ruling monarch, was not at the castle, the stately home occupied by her Bowes Lyon forebears for generations.
